rationale: The workflow defines a multi-configuration matrix (OS x build_type x task_backend) with fail-fast: false, so every matrix cell runs to completion even after one fails. Evidence pattern P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure) and its synthetic fail-fast experiments (fail-fast: false -> true, outcome scenario_passed) support canceling in-flight matrix cells on failure to save CI resources while preserving full build/test coverage on successful runs. The change is minimal (one flag), adds no privileges, secrets, network access, or deployment steps, and does not alter any build or test command. Because required-check/branch-protection semantics were not verified in the repository context, this should be confirmed against branch protection before enabling, and elapsed/summed job time should be measured after rollout given the synthetic evidence scope.
